Methodological_Definition: Published 1-sigma speckle tracking and SAR phase unwrapping noise across Antarctic Peninsula outlet glacier grounding lines
Empirical_Support_Status: Supported by MEaSUREs error budgets (Rignot et al. 2011, 2017; Mouginot et al. 2019)
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Direct measurement error floor; unscaled variance sigma_inst^2 = 225 m^2/yr^2
Consistency_Audit: CONSISTENT: Literature benchmark for satellite InSAR grounding-line velocities

Methodological_Definition: Heuristic variance allowance for cross-sectional shear aggregation between satellite centerline surface velocity and 1-D width- and depth-integrated flowline velocity
Empirical_Support_Status: Provisional (No site-specific transverse velocity survey across 12.4 km Ryder channel)

Methodological_Definition: Quadrature sum of independent error components: sigma_d = sqrt(15.0^2 + 10.0^2) = sqrt(325)
Empirical_Support_Status: Mathematically derived under assumption of statistical independence between sensor phase noise and spatial representation error
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Normalizes observational misfit in objective function J(m) = 0.5 * ((u_gl - u_obs)/sigma_d)^2; sets data weight W_d = 0.003077 (yr/m)^2
Consistency_Audit: CONSISTENT: Exactly matches objective function divisor (18.03 m/yr) and Hessian curvature

Methodological_Definition: Model grounding-line velocity at optimal parameter log10(C_bed*) = 6.9121
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Forward model evaluation at inversion optimum
Consistency_Audit: CONSISTENT: Reproduces target 385.0 +- 15.0 m/yr within 0.05 m/yr

Methodological_Definition: Arithmetic difference between model prediction (384.95 m/yr) and target observation (385.00 m/yr)
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Numerator of objective function misfit term

Methodological_Definition: Normalized misfit against combined data error: -0.05 / 18.03 = -0.00277
Empirical_Support_Status: Standardized metric for objective function misfit contribution (0.5 * z_d^2 = 3.84e-06)
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Evaluates inversion misfit in standard deviations of total uncertainty
Consistency_Audit: CONSISTENT: Well within +-1 standard deviation; optimal fit

Methodological_Definition: Normalized misfit against instrumental error only: -0.05 / 15.00 = -0.00333
Empirical_Support_Status: Evaluates model fit purely against radar sensor accuracy
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Demonstrates model matches observation well within instrument precision alone

Methodological_Definition: Exponential covariance kernel scale C_d(i,j) = sigma_d^2 * exp(-|x_i - x_j| / L_corr)
Empirical_Support_Status: Provisional (Based on satellite multi-looking filter scale ~1-3 km; lacks empirical variogram)
Role_in_Inverse_Problem: Profiles spatial covariance in multi-point inversions; invariant for scalar pilot (N_obs = 1)
